summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch view, coordinate array) pairs with a docstring Note; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator; GridPatchDataset reworked to take dataset, patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; PatchDataset docstring float fix; math import removed), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (test_shape, test_loading_array, plus an extra test_missing_length). Line lengths are within 120 in all edited files except three pre-existing lines in get_valid_patch_size, which are out of scope. Not verified: I did not run tests or repository code as instructed, so test_grid_dataset.py, the pinned values, and the docstring example output are unconfirmed. Nothing was committed. Test images are np.arange(16) reshaped to (1,4,4), chosen because it is the only content consistent with the pinned values.
